observations.description: Deterministic evidence: collect_launch_evidence creates content-addressed evidence_id=SHA-256(canonical body). Deterministic replay. Source hashes sorted and bound to actual file bytes.
Atomic output: write_launch_evidence uses temp+os.replace, read-back via read_launch_evidence. No temp remaining after write.
Bad sources: missing, malformed JSON, non-object, authority=true all reject. trading_authority must be False in all sources.

Watchdog validation: adapter_version must match, readiness.state must be HEALTHY, report_id SHA-256, observations must be list of 2 with exact component set {btc-recorder, es-nq-recorder}, BTC task_running=True, trading_authority=False, heartbeat UTC, gap_count/skew integers (reject bool), gap_count nonnegative.
Recovery drill: schema_version and result must be RECOVERY_VERIFIED. Authority must be False. Report_id SHA-256.
Stale alert drill: schema_version, result, all four booleans (stale_observed, unhealthy_alert_delivered, recovery_observed, healthy_alert_delivered) must be True. Authority False. Report_id SHA-256.
Repository and task facts: repository must be clean (True), checkpoint SHA-256, es_nq_missed_runs nonnegative integer (reject bool), es_nq_last_result integer (reject bool), collected_at UTC.

PowerShell wrapper: requires 5.1, CmdletBinding, ErrorActionPreference=Stop. Uses git rev-parse HEAD + git status --porcelain. Uses Get-ScheduledTask + Get-ScheduledTaskInfo (read-only). No Start/Stop/Enable/Disable/Register/Unregister/Set/New-ScheduledTask. Python runtime existence checked.
No network/credential/live/task-mutation imports in collector. Only argparse, datetime, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, evidence_v1 used.
trading_authority=False hardcoded in evidence body. CLI main() uses datetime.now(UTC). No input can grant trading authority.
Module docstring: 'Fail-closed, read-only assembly'. No owner-approval/profitability/OOS/deployment/unattended-readiness/live-readiness claim.
Direct construction fails closed: bad checkpoint, dirty repository, naive timestamp all reject via direct function call.
